name: Antigua & Barbuda Sim Racing League
description: The premier sim racing league of Antigua & Barbuda, the ABSRL brings together the region's most talented drivers for intense competition across iconic Gran Turismo circuits. Featuring a diverse grid of Gr.3 and Gr.4 machinery, the league emphasizes competitive balance through Balance of Performance, strict penalty enforcement, and reverse-grid qualifying formats. With Jeffery D'ornellas's dominant early performances in the lightweight Mazda RX-Vision setting an uncompromising pace, the championship battle heats up as the season approaches its deciding rounds.
rules: Balance of Performance (BOP) enabled for all races
Collision, shortcut, and pit lane exit penalties enforced
Tuning restricted to brake balance controller only
Reverse grid qualifying format for competitive parity
Mandatory pit stops with compound tire changes required (varies by race)
Damage model set to light damage for all races
Rolling and grid start formats alternate between races
All drivers must complete qualifying to race except in exceptional circumstances
